Clerk.question: How would you be able to use your work skills in a pharmacy environment?
Clerk.overview: Pharmacy clerks are responsible for processing prescriptions, creating labels and filling prescriptions. They work in a fast-paced environment and must remain organized throughout the day. They must be detail-oriented and have a keen eye for detail. Pharmacy clerks must be friendly and have great communication skills. They must be able to multitask and work well in a team environment.

Clerk.question: When are you available?

expectations: Availability during the hours you need them
Flexibility to work evenings and weekends
Clerk.sampleAnswer: I'm available Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

Clerk.question: Why are you interested in this position?
Clerk.overview: The candidate's answer will determine if they are a good fit for the position. They should have specific reasons for applying to the position. They should be able to explain why they are interested in the position and how their skills will benefit the company.
expectations: How their skills will benefit the company
How their skills match the job description
Clerk.sampleAnswer: I am interested in this position because I am looking to expand my clerical skills and gain experience in a new industry. I believe my skills will benefit your company by improving your office's efficiency and productivity.

Clerk.question: Tell me about a time when you worked with your team to accomplish something.
Clerk.overview: Teamwork is essential in an office setting. Clerks work with other office staff to complete daily tasks. The candidate's answer will indicate their ability to work with others and their willingness to do so. The candidate's experience working with a team will prove they are a team player and can work well with others.
expectations: Ability to work well with others
Willingness to work with a team

Clerk.question: How will you benefit the company?
Clerk.overview: The candidate's answer will reveal how they will benefit the company. They should mention their skills and experience that will benefit the company. They should also mention how they will work with other employees and what they can do to improve the company.
expectations: Skills and experience that will benefit the company
How they will work with other employees
How they can improve the company
Clerk.sampleAnswer: I have experience in a fast-paced office environment and have developed superior organizational skills to best manage multiple tasks at once. I'm a people person and enjoy working with others. I'm a hard worker and want to help your company grow.

Clerk.question: What was the worst experience you have had on a job and how did you handle/react to it?
Clerk.overview: A candidate's answer to this question will give you insight into their personality and how they handle stressful situations. The candidate's answer will also give you an idea of how they react to conflict and how they handle stressful situations.

Clerk.question: What is your biggest weakness?

An understanding of the importance of overcoming weaknesses

Clerk.question: How long do you plan to stay with the company?
Clerk.overview: Clerks are a vital part of an office setting. They are responsible for completing daily tasks and keeping the office running smoothly. As a clerk, you want to hire someone that plans to stay with the company for a long time. A candidate that plans to stay with the company for a long time is more likely to be committed to their job and work hard to achieve their goals.
expectations: Willingness to work hard and achieve goals

Clerk.question: What was the turning point in your life?
Clerk.overview: The turning point in a candidate's life is the event that made them decide to pursue a career in office administration. The candidate's answer will help you determine if they are motivated and have a strong work ethic. The answer will also show you if they are goal-oriented and have a plan for their future.

Clerk.question: What is your previous experience?

If they have experience in the same industry, their skills and knowledge will be applicable to your company's needs. If they have experience in a different industry, they may possess skills that are transferable to your company.

Skills and knowledge that are applicable to your company

Clerk.question: How good are your communication skills?
Clerk.overview: Communication skills are vital to the clerical profession. Clerks must communicate with office managers, business partners and customers on a daily basis. Clerk.sampleAnswer: In my experience, great communication and customer service skills improve the way businesses operate, keep customers happy and keep customers returning to the business regularly.

Clerk.question: If you are on a task, and someone asks where something is, do you point to the aisle or take them there?

expectations: Pointing to the aisle or department
Taking customers to the aisle or department
Clerk.sampleAnswer: I would point to the aisle or department and then take them there.

Clerk.question: What is your current role?
Clerk.overview: The candidate's current role is a good indicator of their skills and experience. The candidate's role will also help you determine if they possess the skills and experience you are looking for. If the candidate is currently employed as a clerk, they may not be looking to change roles. The candidate may be in a position that they enjoy and want to stay in.
Clerk.sampleAnswer: I'm currently employed as an office clerk in a medical office.

Clerk.question: How would you handle issues with contractors?

The candidate must be able to communicate with contractors to ensure that they complete their tasks in a timely manner. The candidate must be able to manage contractor expectations and ensure that they meet deadlines.

Clerk.question: What are your career goals?
Clerk.overview: The candidate's goals will help you determine if they are looking for a career in the office or if they are looking for a job to pay the bills. Clerk.question: What is your educational qualification?

Clerk.question: How will you organize massive amounts of information?

expectations: Ability to organize massive amounts of information
Knowledge of how to organize information

Clerk.question: How would you handle an upset customer?

Clerk.question: Have you ever dealt with an angry customer?

Clerk.question: What is the most important thing about a company to you?

The candidate's answer will reveal their attitude toward the company and their perception of its importance. A candidate that values the company and its goals will be more likely to work hard for the company and promote it to others.

Clerk.question: What is your greatest strength?

A skill that makes the candidate an asset to the company
A skill that the candidate is proud of and wants to share

expectations: Ability to think on their feet
Ability to think outside the box
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I would say about 400 marbles would fit into a school bus. The reason for this is because of the size of the marbles and the size of the school bus.

Account Representative.question: What makes you a good fit for our team?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will give you a sense of the candidate's overall interest in your company. The answer will let you know if they have done their research and if they are truly interested in your company.
expectations: Specific examples of how they are a good fit
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am a great fit for your team because I am a strong communicator and I am very customer-centric.

Account Representative.question: How will you sell our product?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will help you to understand how the candidate will approach your clients. You want to know if they are going to be aggressive or passive. You also want to know if they are going to sell the product or the benefits.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I will first spend time getting to know the client and their business. I will then use my knowledge of the product and industry to show how we can help them.

Account Representative.question: When can you join us?
Account Representative.overview: This is a simple question that will give you a sense of how quickly the candidate can join your company. You want to make sure that they are able to join your company as soon as possible.
expectations: Flexibility to work with your schedule
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am available to start immediately.

Account Representative.question: What are your career goals?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will give you a sense of what the candidate is looking for in their career. You can use this to your advantage by offering them a position that will help them achieve their goals. It is also a good way to see if they are looking for a long-term position or if they are just looking for something to fill in the gaps.
expectations: Desires to work on different projects
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I want to be able to work with different clients and industries. I would like to be able to work on different projects and grow within the company.

Account Representative.question: What makes you want to work at JB Hunt?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will give you a sense of the candidate's interest in the company and their desire to work there. Their answer will also give you an idea of what they know about the company and how they feel about it.
expectations: Desire to work for a company that is growing
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am interested in the industry and I love that JB Hunt is a family-owned business.

Account Representative.question: Why should we choose you over the next candidate?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask a candidate that you are considering hiring. It will give you a sense of their confidence and overall ability to sell themselves. The answer to this question will also give you a sense of how the candidate views their own strengths and weaknesses.
expectations: Examples of how they have helped their previous companies
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have the experience and knowledge to help your company grow. I have been with my previous company for over 10 years and have been promoted twice.

Account Representative.question: What is your experience with phone calls?
Account Representative.overview: This is a question that will help you to understand how the candidate interacts with clients. The answer to this question will show you if they are able to effectively communicate with clients over the phone. This is especially important if you have a large number of clients who prefer to communicate over the phone.
expectations: Examples of phone calls that demonstrate their ability to communicate
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I always make sure to get on the phone with my accounts at least once a week.

Account Representative.question: What do you think about competition?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask an account representative because it will show you how they feel about their competition. You want to make sure that they are not overly concerned with their competition and that they are able to focus on the needs of their clients.
expectations: Confident in their ability to win over clients
Willingness to share information with other companies
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am confident in my ability to win over clients. I am always willing to share information with other companies when it will benefit my clients.

Account Representative.question: What was one scenario where you had to learn something new in order to complete a task?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how a candidate learns on the job. You want to see how they approach a new challenge and what they do to learn the necessary information. The answer to this question will also show you if they are able to work independently and if they are able to learn on their own.
expectations: Examples of being able to learn quickly
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I had to learn how to use a new CRM system. I watched a few videos and read through the manual.

Account Representative.question: How do you plan on succeeding in a sales role without any experience?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will show you if the candidate is confident in their abilities. You want to see that they are willing to take on a challenge and that they are not afraid of the unknown. Their answer will also let you know if they have a plan of action for success.
expectations: A plan of action for success
Examples of how they will succeed in a sales role
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have been successful in other roles and I am confident I can do the same here. I am a very hard worker and I am always looking for ways to improve my skills.

Account Representative.question: What was your target in your previous roles?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to get a sense of the candidate's goals and ambitions. You will learn if they are looking to grow with your company or if they are looking for a lateral move.
expectations: Ambition to grow with the company
Goals that align with company objectives
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I want to grow with the company and eventually become a sales manager.

Account Representative.question: What makes you think we are the right fit for you?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask at the end of the interview. It will give you a chance to see how the candidate feels about your company and whether or not they are truly interested in working for you. Their answer will also give you a chance to see if they are willing to work with you and your company.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am very interested in working with your company. I have been looking for a position that will allow me to work with clients and learn more about your industry.

Account Representative.question: How have you kept your customers' revenue consistent?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to learn how an account representative has been able to maintain a consistent revenue stream. It will also give you a sense of the candidate's ability to work with clients and their ability to sell.
expectations: Examples of how they have kept revenue consistent
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I worked with marketing to design a campaign that focused on the client's needs. It increased revenue by 10%.

Account Representative.question: Tell me about yourself and why you are interested in this position.
Account Representative.overview: This is a classic interview question that will give you a sense of the candidate's personality and why they are interested in the position. You want to make sure that they are genuinely interested in the position and that they are not just looking for any job.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have always been interested in the coffee industry and I am excited to be a part of your team.

Account Representative.question: What would you do if you are having a difficult time selling someone on Groupon's services?
Account Representative.overview: Account representatives are often tasked with selling Groupon's services. This question will help you to learn how they approach this type of situation. Their answer will also show you how they handle rejection and whether or not they are able to move on from it.
expectations: Ability to move on from rejection
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I would ask them what they like about their current provider and why they are not interested in Groupon.

Account Representative.question: How would you handle a customer that is refusing payment arrangements?
Account Representative.overview: This question will help you to learn how the candidate deals with difficult clients. You want to see how they handle the situation and if they are able to resolve it in a professional manner.
expectations: Ability to work with difficult accounts
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I would first ask them why they are refusing the payment arrangements and then try to find a solution that works for both of us.

Account Representative.question: How would you approach potential clients?
Account Representative.overview: This question is designed to see how the candidate approaches new clients. You want to see if they are able to engage with new clients in a way that is consistent with your company's overall goals. You will also learn how they approach new clients and if they are able to sell your company's products and services.
expectations: Ability to engage with new clients
Familiarity with sales and closing deals
Specific examples of successful lead conversion
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I would send out a personalized email introducing myself and my company. I would then follow up with a phone call to schedule a time to meet.

Account Representative.question: How do you handle stress?
Account Representative.overview: This question is important because it will show you how the candidate handles themselves when they are under pressure. You want to ask this question because you want to know how they will handle themselves when they are in a difficult situation.
expectations: Examples of how they handled stressful situations
Examples of how they handled stressful situations
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I make sure to take a break and walk around the office. I also make sure to talk to my manager about the situation and bounce ideas off of them.

Account Representative.question: What would make you continue your employment with a company?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to learn what the candidate values in their job. It will also show you how they think about their career and what they want to achieve.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I would continue with a company if I had the opportunity to work with a variety of different clients and expand my skills.

Account Representative.question: What's a problem that you have encountered in the past, and how did you solve it?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to learn how the candidate approaches problems and how they solve them. You can use this answer to see if they are able to solve problems on their own or if they need help from others. Their answer will also show you if they are able to think critically and if they are able to problem-solve.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I was working with an account that was not engaging with our product. I reached out to marketing and we created a new campaign that increased engagement by 10%.

Account Representative.question: Give an example of where you showed persistence, and what was the outcome.
Account Representative.overview: Account representatives are often required to be persistent when it comes to their clients. This question will help you see how the candidate approaches this type of situation. Their answer will show you if they are able to be persistent without being pushy.
expectations: Ability to be persistent without being pushy
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I was working with a client who was hesitant to move forward with a new product. I sent them a few articles that highlighted the benefits of the product and they were convinced.

Account Representative.question: How would you negotiate with me?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how the candidate will handle themselves in a negotiation. You will learn if they are aggressive or passive, and you will also learn if they are willing to negotiate with you.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I would ask you what you are looking for and then I would offer something in between.

Account Representative.question: How did you create relationship and how did that lead to winning a deal?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will help you learn how the candidate works with their accounts. You will learn how they engage with clients and what their approach is. This will also give you a sense of their ability to close deals.
expectations: Examples of how they built relationships
Examples of how they won a deal
Ability to demonstrate their ability to close deals
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I began by asking questions about them and their business. This helped me understand what they needed and what they were looking for.

Account Representative.question: What is the biggest objection you are facing in your sales process?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how the candidate thinks on their feet. You will learn how they handle objections and how they work to overcome them. The answer to this question will also show you if they are able to identify the biggest objection they face and if they are willing to work through it.
expectations: Ability to identify the biggest objection
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: The biggest objection I face is price. I have found that if I can get them to try our product, they are more willing to pay for it.

Account Representative.question: What is your proudest accomplishment?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it allows you to see how the candidate views their own work. The answer will tell you if they are proud of their work and if they are able to take pride in their accomplishments.
expectations: Examples of accomplishments that are relevant to the position
Clear sense of pride in their work
Ability to take ownership of their work
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have been able to increase my accounts' engagement by 10% in the last year.

Account Representative.question: Tell me about a time when you were creative/innovative.
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask an account representative. You want to see how they think on their feet and how they are able to come up with new ideas. The answer to this question will show you if they are able to think outside of the box and if they are able to come up with new ideas that will benefit the company and the client.
expectations: Ability to think outside of the box
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I was working with a client who was not too interested in our services. I decided to send them a gift basket with some of our products and a note thanking them for their business.

Account Representative.question: Tell me about the craziest thing you've done in your life.
Account Representative.overview: This question is meant to gauge the candidate's personality and sense of humor. It will also give you a sense of how they handle themselves in a situation that may be out of the ordinary.
expectations: Ability to think on their feet
Examples of how they handled a crazy situation
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I was in a small town in the middle of nowhere and my car broke down. I had to walk to the nearest gas station and call for help.

Account Representative.question: What are your future plans and how do you plan to achieve them?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will give you a sense of the candidate's ambition and drive. You will learn how they plan to grow and what they see as their future with your company. You will also learn if they are open to new opportunities and challenges.
expectations: Examples of how they have grown in the past
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I would like to grow my book of business by 20% this year. I plan on doing this by increasing our overall conversion rate by 10%.

Account Representative.question: What is your favorite sports team and why?
Account Representative.overview: This is a fun question that will help you learn a little bit more about the candidate. It's not necessary to know the answer, but it will help you get to know them better.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I'm a die-hard Yankees fan. I love the history and the tradition.

Account Representative.question: What is a situation where you made the wrong decision?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how the candidate reacts to their own mistakes. Their answer will show you how they learn from their mistakes and how they move forward.
expectations: Ability to learn from their mistakes
Ability to move forward after making a mistake
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I was working with a new client and I didn't have all of the information I needed. I didn't follow up with them and they went with another vendor.

Account Representative.question: What is your sales growth percentage for the year?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to get a sense of the account representative's overall performance. You will want to ask this question if you are looking for someone who is able to bring in new clients and close deals. The answer will also let you know if they are able to grow their own accounts, which is a critical skill for an account representative.
expectations: Examples of how they grew their own accounts
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have grown my accounts by 20% in the past year.

Account Representative.question: What do you know about our company?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how much research the candidate has done on your company. Their answer will show you if they are truly interested in the position and if they are willing to put in the time to learn about your company.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I know that you are a leader in the industry and that you have been around for over 20 years.

Account Representative.question: What made you interested in working with us?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to find out if the candidate is truly interested in the position. It will also give you insight into what they know about your company and what they think about it.
expectations: Demonstrates interest in the company's products/services
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I was really interested in working with your company because of your focus on customer service and your dedication to making sure your clients are successful.

Account Representative.question: What are your shortcomings?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how the candidate will handle a difficult question. The answer to this question will show you how they are self-aware and how they will work to improve upon their shortcomings.
expectations: Ability to be honest about their shortcomings
Examples of how they have worked to improve upon them
How they will work to improve upon them in the future
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am not always the most patient person. I have worked with a coach to help me with this and I am seeing improvement.

Account Representative.question: What challenges do you think this position will bring, and how would you handle it?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to get a sense of what the candidate is expecting from the position. You will learn how they view the position and what they think they will be doing on a daily basis. This question will also give you a sense of how they handle challenges, and it will show you if they have a plan of action for when things don't go as planned.
expectations: Demonstrates a plan of action for challenges
Ability to work in a fast-paced environment
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I think the biggest challenge will be managing multiple accounts. I will make sure to have a plan of action in place and to follow up with my accounts regularly.

Account Representative.question: What drives you?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will give you a sense of the candidate's personality. You want to know if they are driven by money, success, or something else. This question will also help you to understand if they are motivated by the work itself or if they need a certain type of environment in order to be successful.
expectations: Driven by a desire to help others
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am driven by the satisfaction of helping others.

Account Representative.question: Why should we hire you?
Account Representative.overview: This is a classic interview question that will give you a sense of the candidate's confidence and overall approach. You want to hire someone who is confident in their abilities and who believes that they are the right fit for the job.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am a hard worker and I am always looking to improve. I am eager to learn and I believe that I am the right fit for this position.

Account Representative.question: How do you handle difficult customers?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to find out how the candidate deals with difficult clients. It will also let you know if they are able to handle the 'bad' clients just as well as the 'good' ones.
expectations: Ability to work with all types of clients
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I always try to understand what is causing the client to be upset and then work to resolve it.

Account Representative.question: Why do you think you are a good fit for this position?
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will give you a sense of how the candidate views themselves. The answer will also help you to understand how they view the position and their role within the company.
expectations: Ability to see themselves in the position
Experience and knowledge that makes them a good fit
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am a people person and I love working with clients. I am very organized and I am able to manage my time well.

Account Representative.question: What is a course that you didn't like?
Account Representative.overview: This question is designed to see how the candidate thinks about their education. It is important to know that they are not afraid to be critical of their own education and that they can learn from it.
expectations: Ability to be critical of their own education
Willingness to learn from their mistakes
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I took a course on marketing that was taught by someone who had no real experience in the field. I learned a lot about what not to do.

Account Representative.question: What would your previous employer say about you?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to get a sense of the candidate's reputation. You want to ask this question to see if they have a good reputation and if they are known as a hard worker. You can also use this question to see if they have any negative qualities that you may not have been aware of.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: My previous employer would say I am a hard worker who is dedicated to my clients.

Account Representative.question: What are the qualities of a good outside salesperson?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how the candidate thinks about their peers. The answer will give you a sense of how they view the sales team and how they think about their own role within the sales team.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: A good outside salesperson is able to build relationships with clients and is able to work independently.

Account Representative.question: Why did you choose your course?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a good way to learn about the candidate's career path and how they got to where they are today. It will also give you a sense of their interests and passions.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I chose my course because I love the subject matter and I want to work in the field.

Account Representative.question: Tell me about a time when you had to deal with an upset customer.
Account Representative.overview: An account representative will oftentimes have to deal with upset customers. This question will help you to learn how they handle these types of situations. It will also show you if they are able to stay calm and work through the issue.
expectations: Examples of how they handled upset customers
Ability to remain calm and collected
Ability to work with difficult customers
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I received an email from a customer who was upset about a mistake I made. I called them right away and apologized. I then sent them a gift card for their next purchase.

Account Representative.question: What do your parents do for a living?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to learn more about the candidate's background and upbringing. It will give you a sense of their family life and how they grew up. It will also help you to learn more about their values and how they were raised.
expectations: Values instilled in them by their parents
How they were taught to work
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: My parents are both teachers. They instilled in me the importance of hard work and education.

Account Representative.question: What skills do you have that will make you a good Amica team member?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to learn about the candidate's skills and how they will fit into your company. You can use this question to learn about their technical skills, their soft skills, and their overall work style.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am a quick learner and I am always looking for ways to improve my skills.

Account Representative.question: Why do you want to work in sales?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to get to know the candidate's motivation for wanting to work in sales. Their answer will give you a sense of their passion for the position and their overall goals.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I love working with people and I love helping them find solutions to their problems.

Account Representative.question: What are your core values?
Account Representative.overview: This question will help you to get a sense of the candidate's values and how they align with your company's values. The answer to this question will also let you know if they are willing to be flexible and adapt to your company's culture.
expectations: Values that align with your company's
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I believe in being honest and transparent with my clients.

Account Representative.question: How do you see yourself in this role?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see how the candidate views themselves in the role. Are they confident? Do they have a clear idea of what they want to accomplish? The answer to this question will tell you a lot about the candidate and how they will fit into your company.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am confident that I can help your company grow its business.

Account Representative.question: Have you ever been subject to statistical goals?
Account Representative.overview: Account representatives are often measured on their performance. This question will help you to learn if they are able to meet goals and if they can work with the pressure of meeting those goals.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have been subject to statistical goals and have always been able to meet them.

Account Representative.question: What are your work habits?
Account Representative.overview: This question will help you to learn how the candidate approaches their work. You want to know if they are a self-starter who is able to work independently or if they need constant supervision. You also want to know if they are able to meet deadlines and if they are able to work well with others.
expectations: Ability to work well with others
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am very organized and I have a system for everything. I am also very detail-oriented.

Account Representative.question: How do you handle pressure?
Account Representative.overview: Account representatives are often under pressure to perform. This question will help you learn how they handle that pressure. Their answer will show you how they respond to stressful situations and how they manage their time.
expectations: Examples of how they have handled pressure
How they respond to stressful situations
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have been able to handle pressure by being organized and having a plan of action.

Account Representative.question: Are you willing to relocate?
Account Representative.overview: Relocation is a big deal for many candidates. If you are looking for someone to work in a specific location, you will want to ask this question early on. The answer will give you a sense of how flexible the candidate is and if they are willing to relocate.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: Yes, I am willing to relocate.

Account Representative.question: How do you handle competition?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to learn how the candidate will handle a situation where they are competing with another company for an account. The answer will show you how they handle the competition and how they will go about winning the account.
expectations: Willingness to work with other companies
Examples of working with other companies
Ability to work with other companies
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I am always willing to work with other companies. I have worked with other companies in the past to provide a better solution for my client.

Account Representative.question: Please explain your resume to me.
Account Representative.overview: This is a great question to ask because it will give you a sense of the candidate's ability to communicate their skills and experience. You want to make sure they are able to clearly articulate what they have done and how it relates to the position they are interviewing for.
expectations: Ability to clearly communicate their experience
Examples of how their experience relates to the position
Ability to speak about their skills and experience
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I have been working in an account representative role for the past 3 years. I have been able to work with a variety of clients and develop strong relationships with them.

Account Representative.question: How many clients do you currently support?
Account Representative.overview: This question is important because it will help you understand how much time the candidate will need to dedicate to your company. You want to ask this question to see if they are able to handle the workload that you are expecting of them.
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I currently support 12 clients and spend an average of 3 hours per week with each.

Account Representative.question: Tell me about a time when you had to convince someone of something.
Account Representative.overview: This question is designed to see how well the candidate can sell themselves. You want to see if they are able to sell themselves on the value they bring to the table. The answer will also let you know how well they are able to sell their ideas and products to others.
expectations: Examples of being able to sell their ideas
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I had a client who was not really interested in our services. I was able to convince them that we were the best fit for them and we were awarded the contract.

Account Representative.question: If you asked your friends or family to describe you in two words, 1 professional and 1 personal, what would those words be and why?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to learn more about the candidate's personality and how they see themselves. It will also give you a sense of their personal life and how they spend their free time.
expectations: Personal words that show their personality
Examples of how they live up to those words
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: Professional: Dedicated, I work hard to achieve my goals. Personal: I love to travel and spend time with my family.

Account Representative.question: What is the most important thing about customer service?
Account Representative.overview: Customer service is a critical part of any business. This question will help you learn how the candidate views customer service, and what they think is the most important aspect of it. Their answer will also give you a sense of their overall customer-centric approach.
expectations: Demonstrates a desire to resolve issues
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I believe that the most important part of customer service is making sure that the customer is happy.

Account Representative.question: What are your strengths?
Account Representative.overview: This is a classic interview question that is often asked of account representatives. You want to ask this question in order to get a sense of the candidate's style and approach. You will learn how they engage with clients and what they see as their 'style' that sets them apart from all of the others.
expectations: Consistent in how they engage their accounts
Willingness to spend quality time with their accounts
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: Early on working with an account, I learn what coffee the client drinks. When I visit, I make sure I bring that coffee for them.

Account Representative.question: What do you think about the benefits we offer?
Account Representative.overview: This question is a great way to see if the candidate is aware of the benefits that your company offers. You want to see that they are aware of the benefits and that they are able to discuss them in detail. This will also show you if they are aware of the benefits that your company offers and if they have a positive opinion on them.
expectations: Ability to discuss benefits in detail
Account Representative.sampleAnswer: I think the benefits are great. I especially like the flexibility of the vacation policy.

Assistant Manager.question: What are your strengths and weaknesses?
Assistant Manager.overview: The assistant manager must be able to identify his or her strengths and weaknesses. The candidate must be able to explain how they can improve their weaknesses and use their strengths to benefit the company.
expectations: Explanation of how to improve weaknesses and use strengths to benefit the company
Assistant Manager.sampleAnswer: My strengths include my ability to work well with others and my ability to analyze data. I am also a quick learner. My weaknesses are that I am not as organized as I should be and I tend to procrastinate.

Assistant Manager.question: Why do you want to relocate?
Assistant Manager.overview: Assistant managers relocate to new cities for a variety of reasons. They may be following a spouse who is transferred to a new city for work. They may be seeking a new job in a new city. They may be seeking a new job in the same city but in a different retail store. The candidate must have a positive attitude and be willing to relocate.
expectations: Examples of relocating for different reasons
Assistant Manager.sampleAnswer: I am willing to relocate to any city that has a retail store that needs an assistant manager. I am willing to relocate because I enjoy working in the retail industry and want to expand my career opportunities.

Assistant Manager.question: Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
Assistant Manager.overview: Assistant managers are often promoted to store manager positions. They must have a clear vision of where they want to be in the future and how they will get there. The candidate must have a plan for the future and be able to communicate it to the interviewer.
expectations: Ability to communicate goals and plans to interviewer
Examples of past achievements that support future goals
Assistant Manager.sampleAnswer: I see myself as a store manager in 5 years. I will continue to work hard and gain more experience in the retail industry.

Assistant Manager.question: What is your definition of good customer service?
Assistant Manager.overview: Assistant managers provide customer service to customers entering the store. They greet customers, answer questions about products and assist with purchases. They also take care of customer complaints and resolve issues in a timely manner. The assistant manager must be able to handle difficult customers and resolve issues in a positive manner.
expectations: Ability to resolve issues in a positive manner
Assistant Manager.sampleAnswer: I believe that good customer service is when the customer leaves the store with a smile on their face and a product they are satisfied with.

A candidate should be able to demonstrate leadership in a variety of situations, from leading a small team to leading a large organization. expectations: Demonstrated leadership in a variety of situations
Proven ability to develop others' leadership skills
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I've led small teams of two to four people and large teams of more than 20 people. I've also led volunteer organizations with more than 100 members.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time you had to resolve a conflict between two team members.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: Assistant store managers must be able to resolve conflicts between team members without escalating them. They must also be able to identify potential conflicts and prevent them from arising. A candidate should be able to resolve conflicts in a way that is fair to all parties and that maintains the team's productivity.
expectations: Ability to resolve conflict in a fair manner

I made it clear that they were both responsible and that they had to work together to get the task done. I also made sure they knew that I would not tolerate any further arguing.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What are some current trends you're interested in?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be a trendsetter, not a trend follower. He or she should be aware of current trends in fashion, technology and other areas that affect the store's products or services. He or she should be able to identify how those trends affect the store's business and how the store can capitalize on them.
expectations: Willingness to incorporate them into the store's business model
Ability to articulate how they affect the business
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'm interested in wearable technology, like smart watches and fitness trackers. I think they're a great way to get customers engaged with our brand and products.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How would you encourage the employees to reach the sales goal for that day?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be a leader who can inspire and motivate his or her team members to reach the sales goal for the day. He or she must also be a team player who can work with his or her team members to achieve the goal.
expectations: Proven ability to meet sales goals
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd start by identifying the strengths of each employee and encouraging them to use those strengths to help us reach the goal. I'd also identify areas for improvement and provide training or other resources to help them improve.

Assistant Store Manager.question: When can you join us?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A candidate should be able to provide a specific answer to this question, ideally with a start date.
expectations: Appropriate and realistic time frame for the job
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I can start as soon as possible.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you provided excellent customer service.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be a consummate customer service professional. He or she should be able to identify and resolve customer issues, whether they're complaints or problems, and should be able to provide exceptional customer service in a variety of situations.
expectations: Ability to identify and resolve customer issues
Customer service in a variety of situations
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I once helped a customer find a pair of shoes that were perfect for her. She was so happy with my help that she told all her friends about me.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How would you enhance the business at retail stores?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: The assistant store manager is a key player in the business's success. He or she should have a clear understanding of the business's goals and be able to devise ways to achieve them. He or she should be able to identify and implement effective strategies for increasing sales, increasing customer satisfaction, reducing costs and improving employee morale.
expectations: Ability to devise strategies to achieve goals
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd develop a plan to increase sales by focusing on the most profitable products, like high-margin items and those with high customer demand. I'd also focus on increasing customer satisfaction by improving the customer experience with better training for employees and more effective displays.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How would you coach an employee who has not been offering the in store credit card?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to coach employees to improve their performance. A candidate should be able to identify the root cause of an employee's failure to perform and devise a solution that addresses the problem.
expectations: Ability to identify and address the root cause of a problem
Ability to devise a solution that addresses the problem
Ability to communicate the solution effectively
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd first ask the employee why they haven't been offering in-store credit cards. If they say they don't have enough time, I'd ask them to prioritize it and explain why it's important. If they say they don't have enough information, I'd provide them with a training session on how to offer the cards.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Give me an example how you lead your team successfully complete a merchandising task.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to lead his or her team to success. A candidate should be able to provide a specific example of how he or she led a team to complete a merchandising task, like a new product display or an in-store promotion. The candidate should also be able to explain the reasoning behind the approach and how it was successful.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time you identified an industry trend or a best practice that impacted your team.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be a trend-spotter, identifying and implementing best practices that improve the team's performance. A candidate should be able to identify trends in the industry and how they impact the company's business. A candidate should also be able to identify trends within the company's own operations and how they can be improved.
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I noticed that our competitors were offering free shipping on certain items, so I worked with our logistics department to implement a similar program.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What are your thoughts on sales?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be a skilled salesperson. A candidate should have sales experience, ideally with demonstrable outcomes setting and meeting or exceeding targets. A candidate should be familiar with common types of software systems for tracking inventory and monitoring sales. The candidate should be comfortable planning and performing merchandising, marketing and product display efforts and teaching those skills to team members.
expectations: Skills in merchandising, marketing and displaying product
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I helped my last employer beat sales goals by 30% for eight consecutive quarters through a combination of improving merchandising and analyzing sales and inventory data.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What is your favorite cartoon character?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: The question is designed to see how a candidate responds to an unexpected question.
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: Bugs Bunny. He's clever, funny and always gets the best of Elmer Fudd.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How do you manage people?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be a strong leader and a strong manager. He or she must be able to motivate and inspire team members to perform at their best. He or she must also be able to effectively delegate tasks, provide constructive feedback and discipline when necessary.
expectations: Ability to motivate and inspire team members
Ability to delegate tasks and provide constructive feedback
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'm a natural motivator who can inspire others to do their best work. I'm also a strong leader who can effectively delegate tasks and provide constructive feedback.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How would your colleagues describe you?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: The answer to this question is a good indicator of how the candidate interacts with others. The candidate should be able to identify strengths and weaknesses and explain how he or she would like to improve.
expectations: Ability to communicate effectively with others
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: My colleagues would say I'm a hard worker who is always willing to help out. I'm always looking for ways to improve my performance and that of my team.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How will you ensure your store improves it's KPI Goals?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to effectively manage the day-to-day operations of the store, including sales, inventory, customer service and employee relations. He or she must be able to effectively communicate with and motivate employees to achieve the company's goals.
expectations: Ability to communicate clearly and effectively
Willingness to delegate tasks and responsibilities
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd hold weekly meetings with each department head to review their progress toward their goals and offer suggestions for improvement. I'd also meet with each employee individually to discuss their performance and offer suggestions for improvement.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How will you handle an associate who is under-performing?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to handle a variety of situations, including dealing with an under-performing associate. He or she must be able to identify the cause of the problem and, if it's fixable, offer assistance. If not, he or she must be able to take appropriate action.
expectations: Ability to identify and address the cause of under-performance
Willingness to help an under-performing employee improve
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd first try to determine what was causing the under-performance. If it was a lack of training or knowledge, I'd offer training or coaching. If it was a lack of effort, I'd offer guidance on how to improve. If it was a lack of motivation, I'd try to determine why and address it.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What do you think makes a good software engineer?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A good software engineer is a valuable asset to any company. A candidate should be able to demonstrate an understanding of the role of a software engineer and the skills required to be successful in that role.
expectations: Ability to explain the role of a software engineer
Ability to explain the skills required to be successful in that role

Assistant Store Manager.question: What are the first things you look for when you walk into a grocery store?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be a keen observer of his or her surroundings. He or she must be able to notice and understand how customers and employees interact with the store and its products. He or she must also be able to notice and understand how the store's layout, products and displays are arranged and how they can be improved.
expectations: Ability to understand customer and employee behavior
Ability to notice and understand store layout, product and display arrangements
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd look for ways to improve the customer experience by making sure the store is clean, well-lit and well-stocked. I'd also look for ways to improve employee morale by making sure they're treated with respect.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you were depended on by your team to execute a task that needed a lot of skill.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: Assistant store managers must be able to lead and inspire their team members. A candidate should be able to identify a time when he or she was depended on by a team to perform a task that required a lot of skill and was able to do so successfully.
expectations: Ability to identify a time when he or she was depended on by a team
Ability to perform the task successfully
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I was responsible for training new employees in the use of our inventory software. I had to teach them how to use it effectively and efficiently, which required me to have a strong grasp of the software myself. I was able to train everyone on the team in just two weeks, which allowed them to hit the ground running.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What are your hobbies?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager is a professional, but he or she is also a person with a life outside of work. A candidate should have a variety of hobbies and interests that he or she pursues in his or her free time.

Demonstrated commitment to hobbies and interests
Willingness to discuss hobbies and interests
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I enjoy reading, hiking, playing video games and watching movies.

Assistant Store Manager.question: If you are selected, what will you do to make sure the store succeeds?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A candidate should demonstrate a clear understanding of the store's goals and how he or she will help achieve them. The candidate should also demonstrate a willingness to work hard and to learn and grow in the position.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What are your shortcomings?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A candidate's answer to this question is a good indicator of his or her self-awareness and honesty. A good answer will be honest and specific, not a general statement like "I'm a perfectionist" or "I'm a workaholic."

Assistant Store Manager.question: What was the toughest feedback that you have received?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to accept and act upon constructive criticism. A candidate should be able to identify the source of the feedback and the specific problem it addresses. A candidate should be able to explain how he or she will use the feedback to improve performance.
expectations: Ability to identify and address a problem
Ability to accept and act upon constructive criticism
Willingness to seek out and accept feedback

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you had to resolve an internal or external complaint.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to resolve internal and external complaints. He or she must be able to do so in a way that is fair, consistent and correct.
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I once had to resolve a complaint from a customer who was unhappy with the service he received. I apologized to him and offered him a refund. I then spoke with the employee who served him and told him how to better serve customers in the future.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What is your management style?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to manage people, not just products. A candidate should be able to clearly and concisely describe his or her management style and why it works.
expectations: Awareness of different management style distinctions like democratic, autocratic and laissez-faire
Deliberateness and rationale in choosing a style
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'm a democratic leader who delegates responsibility and authority to team members in order to empower them to make decisions and take ownership of their work.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell us about a project you were responsible for and how you completed it to expectations.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager is a project manager. He or she must be able to plan, organize and execute multiple projects simultaneously while meeting or exceeding expectations. A candidate should be able to discuss a project he or she has completed in detail, including the planning, organizing and execution involved.
expectations: Ability to meet or exceed expectations
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I planned and organized a large inventory re-stocking effort that involved coordinating with vendors, scheduling deliveries and arranging for on-site storage. I also planned and organized a large-scale marketing campaign that involved creating and distributing flyers, arranging for radio ads and scheduling in-store displays.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you had to sacrifice customer service for business needs.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: Customer service is the top priority in retail, but there are times when business needs must take priority. An assistant store manager must be able to make these tough decisions and explain them to customers and co-workers.
expectations: Willingness to apologize for necessary sacrifices

Assistant Store Manager.question: Why do you want to work for us?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager should want to work for the company for which he or she is interviewing. This is a critical question to determine whether the candidate is genuinely interested in the position or just going through the motions.

Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I've been a loyal customer of your company for years and have always been impressed with your quality products and customer service.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Why should we hire you?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A candidate should be able to articulate why he or she is the best person for the job. This answer should include a summary of the candidate's skills and experience, as well as a discussion of how those skills and experiences make him or her the best person for the job.
expectations: Ability to clearly articulate why he or she is the best person for the job
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'm the best person for this job because I have a proven track record of exceeding sales goals, improving inventory management and merchandising. I'm also a great communicator who can work well with people from all walks of life.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you failed to meet the expectations of your customer?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A candidate should be able to admit to failure and explain how he or she learned from it. The candidate should also be able to explain how he or she can avoid repeating the same mistake in the future.
expectations: Willingness to change behavior in the future
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I once failed to meet a customer's expectations by not being able to provide a solution to a problem. I learned that I need to be more flexible and creative when dealing with customers.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How will you handle conflict between two employees?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to resolve conflicts between employees. He or she must be able to listen to both sides, understand the issues and find a solution that satisfies both parties.
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd first make sure I understood both sides of the issue. Then I'd try to find a solution that satisfied both parties.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you motivated an individual or team to achieve a very challenging goal?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: Assistant store managers must motivate their teams to achieve challenging goals. A candidate should demonstrate an ability to do this in a variety of situations, from inspiring a team to work together to motivating an individual to perform at his or her best.
expectations: Ability to inspire a team to work together
Willingness to set and meet challenging goals
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I motivated my team to achieve a very challenging goal by encouraging them to work together and offering my own assistance when needed.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What made you want to work here?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A candidate should have a genuine interest in the company and its products, services or mission. He or she should also be able to explain why he or she is interested in working for the company and not just in the position.
expectations: Genuine interest in the company and its products, services or mission
Demonstrated knowledge of the company and its products, services or mission
Ability to articulate reasons for interest in the company

Assistant Store Manager.question: What are the five ethical decisions you have made?

expectations: Ability to identify and explain past ethical decisions
Willingness to set and adhere to ethical standards
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I've always been honest with my customers, even when it might have cost me a sale. I've worked hard to ensure my employees are well-trained and well-paid. I've never let my personal feelings get in the way of doing what's best for the company.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you had to make a decision that impacted your company.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: Assistant store managers must make decisions on a regular basis. This question is designed to assess the candidate's ability to make sound decisions based on available information and his or her own experience.
expectations: Sound decision-making based on available information
Ability to make decisions despite incomplete information
Willingness to seek out and consider all relevant information
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I had to decide whether to hire a new employee who had a great resume but was lacking in experience. I decided to take a chance on him because he seemed like a hard worker and I knew I could train him.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What has driven your success in previous jobs?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: The best assistant store managers are driven by a desire to succeed and a passion for their work. They are also driven by a desire to help others succeed.
expectations: A desire to help others succeed
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I've always been driven by a desire to succeed and a passion for my work. I've also always been driven to help others succeed.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What were your responsibilities on a specific project at your previous employer?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager is responsible for many projects, both large and small. A candidate should be able to describe a project he or she has completed in the past and explain how he or she contributed to its success.
expectations: Demonstrated ability to contribute to project success
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I was responsible for creating a new employee training program for my previous employer. I was able to streamline the process by using a combination of online and in-person training methods.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How do you handle multitasking?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to handle multiple tasks at once, like dealing with customers, employees and vendors while also completing administrative tasks. A candidate should be able to prioritize tasks and effectively manage time to complete them all.
expectations: Ability to handle multiple tasks at once
Willingness to delegate tasks when appropriate

Assistant Store Manager.question: How will you motivate your manager who does not agree with the policy?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to motivate his or her manager to follow company policy. This is often a difficult task, but the candidate should be able to explain how he or she would go about it.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How long did you hold each position at your current job?

A candidate who has held a position for a long time is more likely to be satisfied with his or her job and less likely to be looking for a new one.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about your previous work experience.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: Previous work experience is a crucial element of the interview process. It provides insight into the candidate's personality, skills and abilities. The candidate should be prepared to discuss his or her previous work experience in detail.

Proven ability to work well with others

Assistant Store Manager.question: How will you help the community?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager is responsible for the store's bottom line, but he or she must also be aware of the community in which it operates. A candidate should have a plan for supporting the community, whether through donations, volunteering or other efforts.
expectations: Awareness of local community needs and resources
Commitment to supporting the local community
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd make sure we donate to local charities and volunteer at them as well. I'd also make sure we support local schools and other organizations.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What is something that you are proud of?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A candidate should be able to demonstrate a genuine sense of pride in his or her accomplishments.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How do you handle a difficult situation?

Ability to take action to resolve the situation
Willingness to seek help when needed

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you had to switch your focus from one task to another.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: Assistant store managers are often pulled in multiple directions at once. They must be able to prioritize their tasks and switch focus when necessary.
expectations: Willingness to delegate or outsource tasks
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I was working on a project when my manager asked me to help a customer. I immediately switched focus and helped the customer.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you have helped someone progress under you.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager is responsible for the development of his or her team members, from hiring to training to performance evaluation. A candidate should be able to demonstrate a history of helping others grow and develop.
expectations: Demonstrable history of helping others progress
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively
Willingness to take responsibility for the success of others

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you were able to lead a team through a difficult time.
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to lead a team through difficult times, whether it's a crisis or simply a time of change. A candidate should be able to describe a time when he or she led a team through a difficult time and how he or she did so.
expectations: Ability to lead a team through difficult times
Ability to communicate clearly and effectively
Willingness to delegate tasks and responsibilities

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time when you exceeded an expectation?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager is expected to exceed expectations in all areas of his or her job. A candidate should be able to identify a time when he or she did so in the past.

Assistant Store Manager.question: How would you handle an employee theft?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: A manager must be able to handle a variety of situations, including theft. A candidate should have a clear understanding of the company's policies and procedures for theft and be able to apply them appropriately.
expectations: Awareness of company's policies and procedures for theft
Ability to apply policies and procedures appropriately
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I'd first make sure I had all the facts. If the employee was stealing, I'd confront him or her with the evidence and give him or her the opportunity to explain. If the employee was stealing, I'd follow company policy and terminate his or her employment.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Tell me about a time you dealt with a difficult situation at work/school and how did you handle or overcome the situation?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager must be able to handle problems and difficult situations in a calm, collected manner. He or she should be able to identify and communicate the problem, seek solutions and implement them.
expectations: Calmness in the face of conflict
Ability to communicate clearly and respectfully
Willingness to set and implement consequences for inadequate compliance
Assistant Store Manager.sampleAnswer: I had a problem with a co-worker who was not pulling his weight. I approached him about it calmly and clearly, outlining the problem and the steps he needed to take to fix it.

Assistant Store Manager.question: Where do you get your inspiration?

expectations: A clear vision for the future
A willingness to learn and grow
A desire to help others succeed

Assistant Store Manager.question: What are the key performance indicators of your project?

Ability to measure and compare to goals

Assistant Store Manager.question: What is your typical day as an assistant manager?

Ability to prioritize and manage time effectively

Assistant Store Manager.question: What is your definition of a job well done?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager should have a clear understanding of what it means to do a job well. expectations: Specific examples of going above and beyond
Willingness to explain how he or she did so
Awareness of what it means to do a job well

Assistant Store Manager.question: What was the most stressful situation you have been in?

expectations: Ability to describe a stressful situation and how he or she handled it

Assistant Store Manager.question: How will you add on to a customers basket?

He or she should also be able to suggest additional items that may be of interest to the customer.

Assistant Store Manager.question: What qualities do you think a store might be lacking?
Assistant Store Manager.overview: An assistant store manager should be able to identify and address problems in the store's operations. He or she should be able to identify and implement solutions for those problems.
expectations: Ability to identify solutions for those problems
