I was devastated, but I knew that I had to get it done as soon as possible. I stayed up all night and finished the project the next morning. The CEO was very impressed with my dedication and hard work.

Executive Assistant.question: What is your experience in this industry?
Executive Assistant.overview: Executive assistants are often the gatekeepers to their executives’ schedules, so it’s important to ensure that they have experience in the industry you’re hiring for. This question reveals a candidate’s level of expertise in your industry, which will help you determine whether they’re a good fit for your company.
Executive Assistant.sampleAnswer: I’ve been working in the technology industry for over 10 years, starting as a customer service representative and working my way up to executive assistant. I know how to navigate the ins and outs of this industry and I’m always eager to learn more.

Executive Assistant.question: What do you know about Netflix culture?
Executive Assistant.overview: Netflix is an entertainment company that produces films and television series. The company is headquartered in Los Gatos, California. Netflix is the world’s largest Internet television network.
Executive Assistant.sampleAnswer: I know that Netflix has a reputation for being a great place to work and that it has a unique culture that emphasizes transparency and freedom. I’ve also heard that the company has a strong focus on customer service and that it’s constantly innovating.

Executive Assistant.question: How do you manage multiple workloads?
Executive Assistant.overview: Executive assistants are often responsible for managing multiple workloads at once. This question reveals how a candidate will prioritize their workload and manage their time effectively.

I use color-coded sticky notes to keep track of my tasks and I always know where my most important projects are. I also use a calendar to schedule meetings and appointments, so I can easily see what’s coming up next.

Executive Assistant.question: How do you handle multiple tasks?
Executive Assistant.overview: Executive assistants are often tasked with handling a wide range of responsibilities, from scheduling meetings to managing calendars to fielding phone calls. This question reveals how a candidate will prioritize and handle these tasks.
Executive Assistant.sampleAnswer: I always make sure that I’m prioritizing my tasks based on the urgency and importance of each one. If I have a lot of work to do, I’ll break it up into smaller, more manageable chunks so that I can get everything done on time.

Executive Assistant.question: What are your areas of improvement?
Executive Assistant.overview: This question reveals how a candidate will respond to constructive criticism. It’s important to understand how a candidate will react to feedback and what they’re doing to improve their skills.

Executive Assistant.question: What are your expectations from a company?

Executive Assistant.sampleAnswer: I expect to be paid fairly for my work and to receive excellent benefits. I also expect to be treated with respect and to have opportunities for professional growth.

Executive Assistant.question: Have you ever had difficulty with a workplace superior, either your own boss or someone in a position of greater authority, and how did you handle that?

expectations: Ability to work with difficult people
Executive Assistant.sampleAnswer: I’ve had to deal with difficult people in the past, but I’ve always tried to keep my cool and focus on the task at hand. I’ve found that it’s best to approach them in a calm and professional manner, even if they aren’t treating me the same way.

Executive Assistant.question: How do you prioritize work from different stakeholders?
Executive Assistant.overview: Executive assistants must be able to prioritize work from different stakeholders, including executives, managers and clients. This question reveals how a candidate will handle this task, which is crucial to the success of any executive assistant.

Executive Assistant.question: Why do you think we should hire you?
Executive Assistant.overview: This question is designed to reveal how a candidate will sell themselves to an employer. Ask this question to find out how a candidate will convince you that they’re the right fit for your company.

I’m also a great communicator who can build strong relationships with my coworkers and clients.
