Manufacturing Engineer.sampleAnswer: I want to be a manufacturing engineer at SS/L because I've worked with your products for years. I've always been impressed with your commitment to quality and customer service. I'm excited to work with you on new products and processes.

Manufacturing Engineer.question: Tell me about your self.
Manufacturing Engineer.overview: This question is a simple way to get to know the applicant better. You'll learn about their interests, hobbies and personality. The applicant should be able to describe their personal and professional goals. They should also be able to describe how they've achieved their goals in the past.
expectations: Ability to communicate goals and achievements,
Manufacturing Engineer.sampleAnswer: I'm a big fan of football. I've been playing since high school and I'm a season ticket holder for the Bears. I've also been working towards my MBA at night school.

Manufacturing Engineer.question: Tell me about a time when you were part of a team that had to overcome challenges.
Manufacturing Engineer.overview: Manufacturing engineers work in teams with other engineers, technicians and production workers. They should be able to describe how they've worked with others to overcome challenges. They should also be able to give examples of how they've helped other team members.
Manufacturing Engineer.sampleAnswer: At National Auto Parts, we had a difficult time with workers stripping out bolts on the assembly line. After a careful analysis, I recommended switching to a different power tool that allowed us to increase the speed of the line and decrease defects.

Manufacturing Engineer.question: How would you go about troubleshooting a process that you had no prior knowledge of?
Manufacturing Engineer.overview: Manufacturing engineers are often tasked with troubleshooting a problem that's occurring on a production line. They must be able to identify the problem and find a solution quickly. Candidates should demonstrate their ability to research the issue and use their knowledge of manufacturing processes to find a solution.
Manufacturing Engineer.sampleAnswer: I've had to troubleshoot a process that was new to me before. I would first research the process and identify what I didn't know. Then, I would talk with the workers and supervisors on the line to get their perspective.

Manufacturing Engineer.question: How do you resolve conflicts?
Manufacturing Engineer.overview: Manufacturing engineers are often tasked with resolving conflicts between workers, supervisors and customers. They should be able to demonstrate conflict resolution skills that involve listening to all parties, analyzing the situation and coming up with a solution. Candidates should also be able to describe how they'd handle a situation if they were unable to resolve it.
expectations: Ability to listen to all parties
Ability to analyze and solve problems,
Manufacturing Engineer.sampleAnswer: I've been in situations where a worker was unhappy with their supervisor and refused to work. I would talk with the worker and supervisor separately and then together to come up with a solution.

Manufacturing Engineer.question: Walk us through a problem you have troubleshot before.
Manufacturing Engineer.overview: Manufacturing engineers are responsible for troubleshooting problems that occur during production. Candidates should be able to describe how they'd analyze the problem and determine the root cause. They should also be able to describe how they'd communicate the problem to other engineers and technicians.
Manufacturing Engineer.sampleAnswer: At National Auto Parts, we had a problem with our assembly line when a bolt fell into a car's engine. I was able to determine the problem was with the power tool we were using and recommended switching to a different one.

Manufacturing Engineer.question: Q: What was the most challenging situation you have faced at work and how did you deal with it?
Manufacturing Engineer.overview: Manufacturing engineers are responsible for maintaining a safe and efficient production line. They must be able to handle any problems that arise, such as equipment failures, quality issues or worker injuries. Candidates should demonstrate how they've handled these situations in the past and what they learned from them.
Manufacturing Engineer.sampleAnswer: I was overseeing a production line when a worker accidentally cut off his finger. I immediately shut down the line and called for medical assistance. I then made sure the other workers were safe before resuming production.

Network Engineer.question: What was your best job and why?

Network Engineer.question: Why do you want to work with us?

Network Engineer.question: What is the OSI model?

Network Engineer.question: How will you differentiate between a hub and a switch?

Network Engineer.question: What is an access list?
Network Engineer.overview: An access list is a security measure that allows or denies network traffic based on the source or destination IP address. The applicant should be able to explain how they would use an access list to protect your network from unauthorized access.
Network Engineer.sampleAnswer: An access list is a security measure that allows or denies network traffic based on the source or destination IP address. I would use an access list to restrict traffic from a specific IP address or range of IP addresses.

Network Engineer.question: How will you describe the network model?
Network Engineer.overview: The network engineer should be able to describe the network model in a way that makes sense to you. They should be able to explain their design decisions and why they made them.

Network Engineer.question: Where do you see yourself in the next five years?

Network Engineer.question: What are the benefits of deploying SDN?

Network Engineer.question: How do you respond to a P1 incident?

Network Engineer.question: What kind of challenges do you face in your current position?

Network Engineer.question: What is the difference between TDP/UDP?
Network Engineer.overview: The network engineer should have a solid understanding of the TCP/IP protocol stack. This question is designed to test their knowledge of the layers and how they interact with each other.
Network Engineer.sampleAnswer: The Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) is responsible for managing the delivery of data packets from one computer to another. The User Datagram Protocol (UDP) is a connectionless protocol that doesn't guarantee delivery.

Network Engineer.question: What is your biggest mistake and how did you handle it?

Network Engineer.question: How would you set up routing through a backup circuit?

Network Engineer.overview: The network engineer should be able to identify the problem and provide a solution. You're looking for an answer that is well thought out and provides a clear solution to the problem.

Network Engineer.question: What are the technologies you have no experience with?

Network Engineer.question: What is TCP/IP and how does it affect you?

Network Engineer.question: How will you add a network interface to a Linux host?

Network Engineer.question: How would you troubleshoot a connection to a server being down?

Network Engineer.question: How do you understand your customer's real requirement?

Network Engineer.question: What network experience do you have?

Network Engineer.question: How do you communicate to a site when there is an outage or difficulties?

Network Engineer.question: Please describe the process of troubleshooting BGP related issues.

Network Engineer.question: What is a network firewall?

Network Engineer.question: What is the protocol used in networking layer?

Network Engineer.question: What did you like about your previous job?

Network Engineer.question: How will you explain the OSPF packet formation?

Network Engineer.question: How will you describe a Frame Relay?

Network Engineer.question: What is the Niquist criteria for a voice call?

Network Engineer.question: How will you describe TCP/IP communication?

If I still can't find anything, I would contact my supervisor for advice. Question: What do you do if you notice something is wrong with a machine? Answer Description: This question is a situational one that tests the machine operator's ability to identify problems and take action to correct them. You can use it to see how they might handle a situation that requires them to make a decision quickly. The best candidates will be able to explain their thought process and how they arrived at their decision.

Machine Operator.question: Why do you want to work with us?
Machine Operator.overview: This question is a good one to ask at the end of an interview. You can use it to see if the machine operator has any specific reasons for wanting to work with your company. It can also help you determine if they have any questions about the job or the company that you can answer.
expectations: Specific reasons for wanting to work with your company
Questions about the job or company,
Machine Operator.sampleAnswer: I'm interested in working here because I like the products you make. I'm also impressed with how you've grown over the years. I would like to be a part of that growth.

Machine Operator.question: What do you mean by quality?
Machine Operator.overview: This question is a general knowledge one that tests the potential hire's ability to analyze problems and prioritize issues on the production floor as necessary. You can use it to help you determine how the machine operator views the usefulness of the equipment with which they will be working. Check for logical reasoning, effective problem-solving skills and specific steps in the maintenance process.
expectations: Ability to organize and prioritize tasks
General knowledge of the importance of machinery
Processes for conducting effective maintenance procedures,
Machine Operator.sampleAnswer: Quality is a combination of several factors. It's about how well we can make a product and how well we can make it in a timely manner. I'm responsible for making sure that all of our machines are working properly so that we can produce at full capacity.

Machine Operator.question: What are you looking for in a university?
Machine Operator.overview: This question is a way to get to know the machine operator's educational background. You can use it to determine if they have the necessary training to work with the equipment you use. It is also a way to learn about their interests and goals for the future.
Machine Operator.sampleAnswer: I'm looking for a university that will help me learn more about my field and prepare me for advancement. I'm interested in taking courses that will allow me to work with new machines and improve my skills.

Machine Operator.question: What kind of machines have you worked on?
Machine Operator.overview: This question is a general one that helps you get to know the machine operator's experience. It is a good idea to ask about specific types of equipment and the tasks they might perform. You can use this question to get a better idea of the potential hire's knowledge and experience with the machines they will be working with.
expectations: Knowledge of how each machine works
Willingness to learn about new machines if necessary,
Machine Operator.sampleAnswer: I've worked on drilling, boring and milling machines in a professional capacity. I hold certificates in heavy and construction equipment, but I'm always ready to expand my horizons to benefit the company.

Machine Operator.question: How do you handle pressure?
Machine Operator.overview: This question is a way to test the machine operator's ability to perform under pressure. You can use it to see how they handle stress and how they might respond to a crisis. Some machine operators are responsible for making sure their equipment is working properly in the event of an emergency.
Machine Operator.sampleAnswer: I'm used to working under pressure. I know that the machines I operate are vital to the company's production schedule. If one of them breaks down, it can be a big problem for everyone. I always make sure I have a backup plan in case something goes wrong.

Maintenance Technician.question: What made you want to work in an off campus college housing environment?
Maintenance Technician.overview: The work environment is a big part of any job. A candidate who's excited about the work environment they're in is more likely to be a good fit for the position.
expectations: Positive attitude toward the work environment,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I like working with people and I'm good at it. I enjoy being able to help people with their problems and I like being able to make their lives easier.

Maintenance Technician.question: What kind of equipment have you used?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Maintenance technicians are often required to use a variety of tools and equipment. A good candidate should be able to list off the equipment they're familiar with and explain how they use it.
expectations: Knowledge of a wide variety of equipment
Ability to explain how they use each piece of equipment
Listing of specific brands and models,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've used a lot of different tools in my time. I've used a lot of different brands and models, but I'm most comfortable with my cordless drill and my tape measure.

Maintenance Technician.question: Do you have a driver's license?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A driver's license is a must for any candidate. It's a good indicator of their ability to operate a vehicle and get around on their own.
expectations: Possession of a valid driver's license
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. I've had my license since I was 18.

Maintenance Technician.question: Tell me about a difficult work situation, and how did you resolve it?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Difficult situations are a part of life, and it's important to know how a candidate will deal with them. A difficult situation can be anything from a client who's unhappy with the work to an employee who's not pulling their weight. The important thing is that the candidate can handle it in a way that doesn't harm the business or their reputation.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I once had a situation where a client was unhappy with the work I did. I was able to resolve it by going back and looking at the work I did and figuring out what I could have done differently. It wasn't easy, but it was worth it in the end.

Maintenance Technician.question: What are your maintenance skills?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This question is a bit more specific than the previous one. Here, the interviewer is looking for specific examples of maintenance skills. This can include anything from electrical work to carpentry to plumbing.
expectations: Willingness to look for new solutions and unexpected causes
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've been working with wood for a long time now. I've done everything from basic carpentry to furniture making. I also know how to do basic electrical work and plumbing.

Maintenance Technician.question: Where do you see yourself in 5 years?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This is a question that's more about the candidate's attitude than their actual career path. A good maintenance technician should be able to see themselves in a position that's comfortable for them and where they can continue to do their job well.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'd like to be in a position where I'm working with a team of people who are all working toward the same goal. I'd like to be able to keep doing my job well and be recognized for it.

Maintenance Technician.question: Can you describe the type of work you do?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Maintenance technicians are a varied bunch. While some may specialize in one area, others may be more generalists. A good candidate should be able to describe the type of work they do in a way that shows they're well-versed in their field.
expectations: Ability to explain work in layman's terms,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm a generalist when it comes to maintenance. I do everything from electrical work to plumbing to carpentry. It's a lot of work, but I enjoy it.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is your electrical experience?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Electrical work is a big part of the maintenance field. Candidates should be able to demonstrate their knowledge of electrical work and how they've used it in the past.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've been working with electricity for a few years now. I've learned a lot about it and have used it to fix a lot of different things. I've worked on everything from light fixtures to air conditioners.

Maintenance Technician.question: Why did you decide to go to the university you went?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This question is a good way to gauge how well a candidate has thought about their education and how it relates to their career. It also shows how well they can explain their reasoning and how they can relate it to the job at hand.
expectations: Good reasons for choosing the university,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I decided to go to the university I did because it was close to home and had a good reputation for the type of work I wanted to do. I was able to get a degree in building maintenance and management while also being able to take classes in electrical work and carpentry.

Maintenance Technician.question: What do you think about a position that does not have a clear path for advancement?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician's job is not one that usually has a clear path for advancement. It's a job that requires a lot of hard work and dedication to get to the top. Candidates should be able to see the value in such a position and not be discouraged by it.
expectations: Willingness to work hard and put in the time
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I think that there are always opportunities for advancement. It's just a matter of being willing to put in the time and effort to get there. I'm willing to do that and I think that I have the skills needed to get to where I want to be.

Maintenance Technician.question: What do you know about our company?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician is going to be working for your company for a long time. It's important that they know what your company does and what it stands for. This will help them better understand the work they're doing and the people they're doing it for.
expectations: Willingness to learn about the company,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've read up on your company and its history. I know that you were founded in 1972 and that you've been in the business of providing home maintenance services ever since. I also know that you have a reputation for being honest and reliable.

Maintenance Technician.question: What do you know about TransCanada?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Most maintenance technicians will work for a variety of different companies over the course of their career. It's important to know what the company you're applying to does and what they're all about.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I know that TransCanada is a large company that deals with a lot of different things. They have a lot of different departments that handle everything from maintenance to construction and even security.

Maintenance Technician.question: Tell me about a time when you had to apply safety rules?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Safety is a big part of the maintenance technician's job. The best candidates will have a story or two about how they've applied safety rules to their work.
expectations: Willingness to look for new solutions and unexpected causes
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I was working on a project that involved some electrical work. I was told to be careful with the equipment and to keep the area around me clear of any flammable materials. I made sure to do that and didn't have any problems.

Maintenance Technician.question: What are your weaknesses?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Candidates should be honest about their weaknesses. It's not a bad thing to have them and it's better to be upfront about them than to try to hide them.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm not the best at keeping up with the latest technology. I'm always trying to learn new things, but I'm not as quick as some of my colleagues.

Maintenance Technician.question: Without paper, is 3,599 prime or not prime?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This is a classic test of a candidate's ability to think outside the box. It's not about whether they know the answer but how they get there. A good candidate should be able to take a problem and find a solution that doesn't rely on rote memorization.
expectations: Ability to think outside the box
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm not sure if it's prime or not. I guess I could try dividing it by 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 11 to see if it's divisible by any of them. If it's not divisible by any of them, then it must be prime.

Maintenance Technician.question: How would you handle a angry resident complaining about a problem with the plumbing?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician has to be able to deal with a lot of different people and personalities. Some are going to be upset about something and it's up to the technician to diffuse the situation. A good candidate should be able to do this in a calm and professional manner.
expectations: Ability to remain calm under pressure
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'd try to get as much information as possible from the resident about what's wrong. If they're not clear on what's happening, I'd try to get them to explain it in more detail. Once I have an idea of what's wrong, I'd try to explain what I'm going to do and why.

Maintenance Technician.question: What projects have you worked on?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician's job is a lot more than just fixing things. They're also responsible for making sure that everything is in working order and that the property is in good condition. A candidate should be able to give you a rundown of the projects they've worked on and what they've done to make them successful.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've worked on a lot of different projects at my current job. I've helped with the maintenance of the building itself, including cleaning and painting. I've also worked on projects for the tenants, such as installing new appliances and repairing broken ones.

Maintenance Technician.question: Please analyze your group's performance in the group activity.
Maintenance Technician.overview: A group activity is a good way to gauge how well a candidate will work with others. The candidate should be able to give an honest and detailed analysis of how they performed and what they could have done better.
expectations: Ability to look at performance objectively
Ability to work well with others,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I think we did pretty well overall. We were able to get through the task in the time allotted and I think we were all on the same page about what we were doing. I think I could have been a bit more vocal about what I was doing and why, but it all worked out in the end.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is the most important factor when troubleshooting an issue?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A good maintenance technician should be able to figure out what's wrong with a system or device. This is usually done by eliminating possible causes and narrowing down the issue. The most important factor is being able to do this in a timely manner.
expectations: Willingness to look for new solutions and unexpected causes
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I usually start by figuring out what the problem isn't. This is usually done by talking with the client and going over the report they submitted. From there, I'll try to narrow down the issue by eliminating possible causes.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is your mechanical experience?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician's job is a lot more than just fixing things. They have to be able to diagnose problems, order parts, and install them. Candidates should have a good grasp of the basics of mechanical work to be able to perform their job well.
expectations: Knowledge of tools and their uses
Familiarity with common parts and their uses,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've done a lot of basic mechanical work in the past. I've fixed a few cars, built a few things, and even put together a few pieces of furniture. I'm not an expert by any means, but I know my way around most tools and how to use them.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is your favorite sports team?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This is a simple question that can reveal a lot about a candidate. It's not a matter of whether or not they like the team, but how they feel about it. Do they have an emotional investment in the team? Do they have a favorite player? Do they follow the team closely?
expectations: Ability to be loyal to a team
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm a big fan of the [team]. I've been following them since I was a kid and I've been to several games. I'm also really interested in the [player] and try to follow his career as much as possible.

Maintenance Technician.question: How will you troubleshoot a machine if it is down?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Troubleshooting is a huge part of maintenance work. A good candidate should be able to figure out what's wrong with a machine and fix it. This is a question that tests both the candidate's knowledge and their ability to communicate that knowledge to others.
expectations: Ability to explain technical information in layman's terms,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'll start by checking the obvious things like making sure the power is on and the machine is plugged in. If that doesn't work, I'll check the circuit breaker or fuse box to make sure it's not tripped. If it's not that, I'll look for anything out of the ordinary like loose wiring or a loose connection.

Maintenance Technician.question: If I only had one position available and two candidates, why would you be the best fit for this job?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This question is a bit of a doozy. The best way to answer it is to be honest and specific about why you're the best fit for the job. It's a good idea to talk about your experience, your skills, and your personality.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm the best fit for this job because I have the right experience and skills to do it well. I've been working in maintenance for five years now and have experience with all of the tasks that come with this job. I'm also a very hard worker who's willing to go above and beyond to get the job done.

Maintenance Technician.question: What do you see in your future?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This question is a good way to gauge a candidate's career goals. While it's not necessarily a deal-breaker, it's important to know if a candidate is looking to stay in the maintenance field or if they're just looking for a job.
expectations: Willingness to learn new skills and take on new challenges,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm hoping to continue working in the maintenance field for a while. I've been doing this for years now and I'm still learning new things. I'd like to see what else I can learn and how far I can go in this field.

Maintenance Technician.question: If you had two customers in an emergency who needed work done and you knew you could not accomplish both in the time they wanted,, how would you handle the situation?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician's job is to make sure that the customer is happy. That's easier said than done when there are two customers who need work done and you can't do it all. The best way to deal with this situation is to be upfront with both parties and let them know what you can do for them.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'd talk with both customers about their needs and see if there's any way I can help them both out. If not, I'd have to prioritize the one that needs help the most. If they're both in a similar situation, I'd try to help the one who has been waiting longer.

Maintenance Technician.question: How do you deal with different types of people?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician will often have to deal with people of all walks of life. They'll have to be able to deal with the elderly, the young, and people of different ethnicities and backgrounds. A good candidate should be able to deal with all of them with aplomb.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I try to treat everyone the same way. I know that's not always possible, but I try to keep an open mind and be respectful. I also try to remember that everyone has their own way of doing things and that's okay.

Maintenance Technician.question: How do you feel about working in a busy environment around injured animals?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Veterinary clinics are a unique environment for maintenance technicians. Animals are often injured and in need of care, but they're also very sensitive to loud noises and sudden movements. A good candidate should be able to work in this environment without making things worse for the animals.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've worked in a veterinary clinic before so I'm not too worried about this. I know how to handle myself around animals and I'm used to working in a busy environment.

Maintenance Technician.question: Have you and a peer ever disagreed?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Disagreements are bound to happen between coworkers, especially when they're working on the same project. A good candidate should be able to work through these disagreements and come to a solution that works for both parties.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: It's happened a few times. I usually try to talk with the other person and see if we can come to an agreement. If not, I'll go over my reasoning for my decision and see if they can come around to it. If not, I'll have to stick with my decision.

Maintenance Technician.question: What would you do if a 480 volt conveyor system stopped working?
Maintenance Technician.overview: The best way to handle a problem is to prevent it from happening. However, that's not always possible and sometimes a technician has to deal with a situation that's already in progress. In these cases, it's important to be able to think on your feet and come up with a solution to the problem.
expectations: Ability to think on one's feet
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: The first thing I would do is make sure everyone was out of the area. Then I would try to figure out what caused the issue and if there was anything I could do about it. If not, I would call in a supervisor or someone who could help me fix the problem.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is your best attribute?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This is a question that's meant to get a candidate talking about themselves. It's important to ask this question because it will give you a good idea of what the candidate considers their best quality. This can be a good indicator of how they'll work with others.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I think my best attribute is my ability to work with people. I've always been able to get along with just about anyone and I think that's a big part of why I'm so successful in my line of work.

Maintenance Technician.question: How would you diagnose an electrical fault?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Electrical faults are some of the most dangerous problems a maintenance technician can encounter. The best way to deal with them is to be able to identify the problem quickly and accurately. This requires a good understanding of electrical systems and the ability to use that knowledge to figure out what's wrong.
expectations: Ability to use logic and reasoning to solve problems
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I would start by checking the circuit breaker and fuse box to make sure that the issue isn't there. If it isn't, I'd check the wiring for any signs of damage or wear. I'd also check for any signs of water damage or corrosion. If I still can't find anything, I'd have to call in an electrician.

Maintenance Technician.question: What experience do you have in the maintenance field?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A candidate's experience in the field is a good indicator of their ability to do the job. It's important to know what they've done and what they're capable of doing.
expectations: Examples of maintenance work done in the past
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've been working as a maintenance technician for the past three years. I've worked on a wide variety of projects from electrical work to plumbing to carpentry. I'm comfortable with all kinds of tools and have a good eye for detail.

Maintenance Technician.question: What kind of welding experience do you have?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Welding is a skill that maintenance technicians need to have. Welding is used for a variety of tasks from building structures to repairing them. A candidate should be able to explain the kind of welding experience they have and how it applies to the job.
expectations: Knowledge of different types of welding
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've worked with a number of different kinds of welding. I've used MIG, TIG, and arc welding in the past. I'm most comfortable with MIG and TIG, but arc welding is also something I'm familiar with.

Maintenance Technician.question: What would you do if you couldn't fix something?
Maintenance Technician.overview: The maintenance technician's job is to fix things. If they can't fix something, it's a big problem. Candidates should be able to explain how they would go about finding help and what they would do if the problem was too big for them to handle.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: If I can't fix something, I'll usually try to find someone who can. I'll talk with the client and see if they have any recommendations for someone who might be able to help. If not, I'll look into what other options are available.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is the most common cause of a frozen up indoor coil?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Indoor coils are a common problem for maintenance technicians. A good candidate should be able to identify the most common cause of a frozen up coil and how to fix it.
expectations: Knowledge of the most common causes of problems
Willingness to look for new solutions and unexpected causes,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: The most common cause of a frozen up indoor coil is usually a lack of airflow. This can be due to a number of things such as a clogged filter or air ducts that are blocked by debris. I usually check these things first when I'm called in to fix an issue.

Maintenance Technician.question: Why do you want to work with us?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This question is a bit of a catch-all for the interview. It's a chance for the candidate to show their enthusiasm for the job and for you to see how well they can sell themselves.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've always been interested in the maintenance field. I like the idea of working with my hands and fixing things. I'm also very interested in working with people and helping them out with their problems.

Maintenance Technician.question: What are your plans for the future?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Maintenance technicians are often the unsung heroes of the business world. They're the ones who keep everything running smoothly and are often the first to know when something is wrong. As such, they're in a unique position to see the bigger picture and plan accordingly.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm looking to move up in the company. I've been doing maintenance for a while now and I think it's time to take on a bigger role. I've been looking into management positions and I think it would be a good fit for me.

Maintenance Technician.question: How would you handle a situation if someone started yelling and acting irate?
Maintenance Technician.overview: There's a lot of stress that comes with being a maintenance technician. It's not uncommon for people to get upset when something breaks or doesn't work. A good candidate should be able to handle this situation with a level head and be able to explain the situation in a way that calms the person down.
expectations: Ability to explain complex issues in a simple manner,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'd try to calm the person down and explain what's going on. If they're still upset after that, I'd try to get them to talk about what's bothering them. Sometimes, it's just a misunderstanding that can be cleared up quickly.

Maintenance Technician.question: What do you know about ATI?
Maintenance Technician.overview: The company you're interviewing for is a big part of your life. You should know about it and what it does. This question is a good way to gauge how much you know about the company you're applying to.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I know that ATI is a leading manufacturer of home improvement products. I've heard that they're a great place to work and that they have a lot of opportunities for growth.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is a problem you have had with your co-worker and how did you solve it?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A lot of people work in teams, and it's important to be able to work well with others. A candidate who can't get along with their co-workers is not going to be a good fit for any company.
expectations: Ability to work well with others
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've had a few problems with my co-workers in the past. I've found that the best way to deal with them is to talk about it. I'm not one to hold grudges and I like to think that most people are the same way. If you can talk about it, you can usually solve it.

Maintenance Technician.question: How would you handle a co-worker who does not want to listen to directions or is doing things improperly?
Maintenance Technician.overview: While it's important to be able to work with others, it's also important to be able to work with people who are less experienced or who aren't as good at their jobs. A good candidate should be able to handle these situations without getting frustrated or resorting to yelling.
expectations: Willingness to work with people of varying skill levels,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I try to be as patient as possible when working with someone who doesn't know what they're doing. I try to explain things as I'm doing them and make sure they understand what I'm saying. If they're still having trouble, I'll try to find someone else who can help them out.

Maintenance Technician.question: What kind of experience do you have with this?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A candidate's experience is a good indicator of how well they can perform on the job. A maintenance technician should have a good amount of experience in the field and be able to show you where they've worked and what they've done.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've been working in the maintenance field for about five years now. I started out as a general laborer and worked my way up to where I am now.

Maintenance Technician.question: What reading would you get by measuring the voltage between one leg of a 480v 3 phase motor and ground?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Electrical work is a big part of maintenance work. Candidates should be able to answer questions about the electrical systems they're working with. This is a basic question that should be easy to answer.
expectations: Willingness to look for new solutions and unexpected causes,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: By measuring the voltage between one leg of a 480v 3 phase motor and ground, you can tell if the motor is running. If it's not, you can check the voltage on the other two legs to see if they're running.

Maintenance Technician.question: What type of lumber should be used for framing a wall on the concrete floor?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Framing walls is a common task for maintenance technicians. While the question is fairly straightforward, the answer is not. A good candidate should be able to explain why certain types of lumber are better than others in certain situations.
expectations: Knowledge of the properties of different types of lumber
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: The type of lumber you use for framing a wall on a concrete floor depends on a few things. If you're framing the wall on top of a slab, you'll want to use either steel or wood studs. If you're framing the wall on top of a concrete floor, you'll want to use wood studs.

Maintenance Technician.question: Can you work on rotating shifts?
Maintenance Technician.overview: Some maintenance technicians work on rotating shifts. This can be a difficult thing to adjust to but is a common practice. Candidates should be able to work on rotating shifts if needed.
expectations: Ability to adapt to new situations
Willingness to work in a variety of environments
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've worked on rotating shifts before and I'm willing to do it again if needed. I've found that it's important to keep a regular schedule as much as possible so that you don't get too out of sync with your body's natural rhythms.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is your experience in this field?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This is a question that's going to be asked of every candidate. It's important to remember that the interviewer is looking for more than just a job history. They want to see how you've grown as a technician and how you've been able to handle the challenges of the industry.
expectations: Ability to work in a variety of situations
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I've been working as a maintenance technician for about five years now. I started out doing small jobs like cleaning gutters and painting fences but have since moved on to bigger projects like electrical work and plumbing.

Maintenance Technician.question: What are your strengths?
Maintenance Technician.overview: This is a pretty standard question, but it's still important. A candidate should be able to talk about their strengths in relation to the job they're applying for.
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: I'm very good at working with people. I'm able to get along with just about anyone and I'm always willing to help out a friend in need. I also have a lot of experience working with my hands, so I'm pretty good at repairing things.

Maintenance Technician.question: What do you think makes a good team?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A team is only as good as its members. A candidate who can articulate what makes a good team will be able to work well with others and be a valuable asset to any team they're on.
expectations: Ability to work in a team environment,
Maintenance Technician.sampleAnswer: A good team is one that's made up of people who are willing to work together and help each other out. I've been on teams like that before and they're always the most successful.

Maintenance Technician.question: What is your work history?
Maintenance Technician.overview: A maintenance technician's work history is important for a number of reasons. It shows how long they've been in the field, what kind of work they've done, and how they've performed. A good candidate should be able to provide a solid work history that shows they're capable of doing the job.
